title: Decide whether to reach sellers directly, not only through search
question: Authorize one non-search seller channel (for example, contacting for-sale-by-owner listings or absentee-owner records) run under the investor entity, never the newsroom, with a monthly budget and CAN-SPAM/TCPA compliance: yes with a budget, or no?
cost_of_delay: At roughly 300 pageviews a month, search alone yields about one seller lead every two years (estimate from assumed click and submit rates, not measured). Each week without a direct channel is a week with no seller pipeline.
default_if_unanswered: No: the routine stays search-only and stops proposing outbound channels.
